completeDateTime.description:
The date, time, date time or other date time value for a complete specified period of time expressed as a specific
month, a specific week, etc.

startDateTime.description: The date, time, date time or other date time value for the start of this specified period of time.

allOf.$comment: Inlined utility base type UneceSpecifiedPeriod so utility transformations can operate on concrete properties instead of a $ref.
